get.description: The calling principal: user or API key, its org, role and scopes.
The org with its effective limits (plan values overlaid by overrides) and balance in dollars.

patch.description:
Rename the org or change its retention; `retention_days` and `recording_retention_days` also need the
`org.compliance` permission.

get.description: Every member of the org, oldest membership first.
Every unaccepted invitation, newest first; expired ones are listed with ``status: "expired"``.

post.description: Invite an email address into the org (7 days, single use); only owners can invite owners.

delete.description: Revoke an unaccepted invitation, so its link stops working; owner invitations only by owners.
Remove a member (also oneself); owners can be removed only by owners, and the last owner stays.

patch.description: Change a member's role; owners can be made or demoted only by owners, and the last owner stays.

get.description: The org's OIDC connection (never its client secret).

post.description: Make another member an owner and the calling owner an admin; needs a sign-in in the last 10 minutes.

get.description: Every direct sub-account of this org, oldest first.

get.description: One direct sub-account of this org.
